conflicts.reason: Two CHM specimens. 102673389 is catalogued as the NES-001 console (with its power supply) and names the model correctly; 102752124 misprints the model as NEW-001. Neither is a maker figure.

notes: BODY (museum tier): Computer History Museum 102673389, 'Nintendo Entertainment System console', model NES-001, 'Object consists of console and power supply.' The record prints '10 1/8w x 3 3/4h x 8l (in)' and '25.72w x 9.52h x 20.32l (cm)'; CHM labels w/h/l, mapped w→width, h→height, l→depth (CHM cataloguing convention, not Nintendo's own labels). The box is the record's centimetre line shifted to millimetres (no conversion of ours). CHM's mass '2 (lb)' is a whole-pound figure and is not used.

A second CHM record, 102752124 (NES console; its model field misprints 'NEW-001'), prints '10 1/4w x 3 1/2h x 8l (in)' / '26.04w x 8.89h x 20.32l (cm)'. Both are recorded in conflicts[]; 102673389 is chosen because it is catalogued as the console (plus its separate power supply) with the correct model number.

Nintendo of Europe's History page (https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Hardware/Nintendo-History/Nintendo-Entertainment-System/Technical-Details/Technical-Details-627027.html) prints 'Size 255mm x 85mm x 202mm' with NO axis labels; under the lane rule it is not filed in the box (the order cannot be assumed). It describes the PAL NES, an NES-001 body. It disagrees with both CHM specimens on height (85 vs 95.2 / 88.9 mm); a maker figure with labelled axes would supersede the museum one.

ports/controls: from the scan of Nintendo of America's 1988 Control Deck instruction manual (archive.org item Nintendo_Control_Deck_Manual_1988), section '1. NES COMPONENTS'; quotes are that scan's OCR text layer, clean lines only. CONTROLLER SOCKET 1/2 → controller_proprietary 2; VIDEO-OUT JACK → composite_out 1; RF SWITCH JACK → rf_out 1; AC ADAPTER JACK → power_in 1. AUDIO-OUT JACK has no §3 kind (noted, not filed). The components page does not show the bottom expansion connector; it is therefore not filed. Labels POWER SWITCH → power_switch and RESET SWITCH → reset_button (the manual's own words 'push the reset button'). The 'Ch. 3/Ch. 4 SWITCH' is in the list but its form is not printed, so it is not mapped to slide_switch.
media: the manual says 'Open the Chamber Lid', insert the Game Pak into the Chamber and press it down until it locks; the insertion face (front) is not printed as a word, so media stays uncovered.

external_ids: Wikidata Q34468618 ('Western version of Nintendo Entertainment System'); that item has no P5795. The platform item Q172742 carries IGDB 'nes'; igdb_platform is left null here because it is not on this object's item.
